extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / users attempting to create a new article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural requirements for creating (or diagnosing why you cannot view/create) a new Wikipedia article page, including account requirements, searching for existing content, and troubleshooting deletion or visibility issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only logged-in, autoconfirmed users may create pages; if you cannot create the page, ensure you are signed in and meet the autoconfirmed criteria (or use alternative submission paths).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the Article Wizard or submit a draft
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot directly create a page (e.g., due to account age), use the Article Wizard to prepare and submit a draft or use the 'request a new article' processes so experienced editors can assist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles / alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for 'Comedy legacy essay' in existing articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, check whether the topic already exists under a different title or spelling; use Wikipedia search to avoid duplication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inspect 'What links here' to find references to the intended title which may indicate redirects, merged content, or alternative coverage locations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allow for recent-creation visibility delay and try purge
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you believe the page exists but cannot see it, wait for database updates or purge the page to refresh cached views before concluding it's missing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case-sensitivity and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Try different capitalizations for the title (beyond the first character) and, when appropriate, create redirects so users can find the article under common variants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check deletion log and deletion reasons
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a prior page was removed, consult the deletion log and the linked guidance on deletion reasons to understand whether the topic meets notability or other policies before attempting recreation.
